note: Play in order. Stage 2 is the one that saves a playthrough: every missable trophy lives in a single story moment, so make a manual save before each mission it names. Everything after stage 2 can be done in free roam, in any order.

stages.goal: Finish all four chapters and the final mission, and take the story trophies as they come.
tips: Play the missions in order; chapter trophies pop on their own.
Before each chapter, open the missable list and make a manual save.
Take stranger and contact jobs when they appear instead of leaving them for the endgame.
stages.title: First playthrough — the story

stages.goal: Earn all 7 missable trophies inside their one-time story moments.
tips: Manual save before VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory and the showroom mission.
Hot Together and Retail Therapy need your partner beside you — do them in a duo stretch of the story, not in free roam.
Bad Luck, I Guess needs a failed first attempt: if an attempt fails, retry it in place instead of reloading.
stages.title: Missables — before their moments pass

stages.goal: Close every contact finale, finish 8 stranger strands, and clear the activity trophies.
tips: Work the shooting range early — 42 gold medals take the longest of any activity.
Try all 9 activity types once for Master of None before chasing wins.
Hunt, fish and bowl in one Vice City tour to knock out several trophies in an afternoon.
stages.title: Strangers, contacts and activities

stages.goal: Sweep Leonida: cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, meditation spots and all 52 areas.
tips: Collect card sets one set at a time so no set is left one card short.
WAiNK spots cluster in Vice City — walk downtown and Ocean Beach first.
Drive everything you pass: 100 vehicles and 52 areas clear on the same road trip.
stages.title: Collectibles and the map

stages.goal: Turn the story's fortune into the money trophies: vaults, trucks, gangs, laundering, spending and garages.
tips: Launder Marked Bills after every big job — do not let them pile up.
Buy the 8 garages last, when the heist money is in.
Register garage cars to the Scooter Bros app as you buy them.
stages.title: Money, heists and properties

stages.goal: Reach 100% completion, then watch the platinum pop.
tips: Open the stats page: it lists exactly what the last percent is made of.
Use the tracker's export to keep a backup of your progress before the final sweep.
A Long Road pops at 100% — the platinum follows with the last trophy, whichever it is.
stages.title: Clean-up and the platinum

title: Road to the Platinum
